No badge — plain icon button
badge: true — the dot
badge: 3, badge_id: 'inbox-badge' — count pill, Turbo-Stream-replaceable
badge_id: alone — hidden empty target a stream can light up later
href: — renders an <a>
99+ active: true, badge: 128 — current section (aria-current="page") and the capped pill (max_count: defaults to 99)
